<img src="assets/hex-sticker.png" align="right" width="160" alt="Mixed-Sign Coxeter Systems hex sticker" />

Python package, Lean 4 formalization, interactive Shiny Explorer, Manim presentation, and Quarto research portal supporting:

> Johnathon Kyle Armstrong, *Principal Elements of Mixed-Sign Coxeter Systems*, Ph.D. Dissertation, Florida State University, 2012 ([FSU Digital Library PDF](https://repository.lib.fsu.edu/islandora/object/fsu:182755/datastream/PDF/view) · [Download](https://repository.lib.fsu.edu/islandora/object/fsu:182755/datastream/PDF/download)).

- **Research Portal (Quarto + GitHub Pages):** [https://jkylearmstrong.github.io/mixed.sign.coxeter.systems/](https://jkylearmstrong.github.io/mixed.sign.coxeter.systems/)
- **Interactive Explorer (In-Browser Shinylive):** [https://jkylearmstrong.github.io/mixed.sign.coxeter.systems/explorer.html](https://jkylearmstrong.github.io/mixed.sign.coxeter.systems/explorer.html)
- **Full Writeup & Verification Notes:** ([HTML](docs/mixed_sign_coxeter.html) · [PDF](docs/mixed_sign_coxeter.pdf) · [source](docs/mixed_sign_coxeter.qmd)) and [computational verifications note](docs/verifications.md).

## Repository Layout

```{python}
#| echo: false
from pathlib import Path
n_lean = len(list(Path("lean/MixedSignCoxeter").glob("*.lean")))
```

| Directory / File | Contents |
| :--- | :--- |
| `src/mixed_sign_coxeter/` | Python package: `ReflectionSystem`, `MixedSignCoxeterGraph`, group/root utilities, Appendix A–D catalogs, and exhaustive searches (`isomorphisms.py`, `finite_search.py`, `principal_search.py`) |
| `lean/MixedSignCoxeter/` | `sorry`-free Lean 4 (`v4.35.0` + Mathlib) formalization across `{python} n_lean` modules covering Chapters 1–3 (Howlett's formula, bipartite & tree conjugacy, Deletion/Exchange & Coxeter presentation, positive roots and length (Prop. 3.10) with faithfulness of the geometric representation, parabolic transfer, spectral classification & interlacing, and counterexamples) |
| `explorer/` & `website/explorer.qmd` | Interactive **Shiny for Python** explorer (`explorer/app.py`) + in-browser **Shinylive** page (`website/explorer.qmd`) for building signed graphs, comparing linear vs. bipartite principal orderings, and checking theorems |
| `data/theorems.yml` | Shared traceability registry connecting Dissertation → Lean 4 → Python → Interactive Explorer |
| `slides/` | 11-scene Manim presentation (`dissertation_deck.py`) backed by exact package computations (`deck_content.py`) and speaker script (`SCRIPT.md`) |
| `website/` | Quarto research portal source (`_quarto.yml`, `index.qmd`, `dissertation.qmd`, `lean-verification.qmd`, `spectral-results.qmd`, `examples.qmd`, `explorer.qmd`) rendering to `docs/` |
| `docs/` | Rendered Quarto research portal HTML output, plus the full writeup (`mixed_sign_coxeter.qmd` source with `bib.bib`, and its HTML/PDF/DOCX) and `verifications.md` |
| `scripts/` | Maintenance scripts: `sync_theorem_registry.py` (refreshes `data/theorems.yml` source links), `lean_module_graph.py` (regenerates the Lean dependency diagrams), `generate_hex_sticker.py` |

## Python Package & Tests

```bash
pip install -e ".[dev]"
pytest -v
```

```{python}
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, "src")

from mixed_sign_coxeter import MixedSignCoxeterGraph

g = MixedSignCoxeterGraph.example_3_33()
print("Bipartite:", g.is_bipartite())
print("Linear principal spectral radius:   ", round(g.spectral_radius([0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5]), 5))
print("Bipartite principal spectral radius:", round(g.spectral_radius([0, 3, 5, 1, 2, 4]), 5))
```

## Lean 4 Formalization

```bash
cd lean
lake exe cache get
lake build
```

## Interactive Shiny Explorer

Use the **in-browser Shinylive Explorer** at [jkylearmstrong.github.io/mixed.sign.coxeter.systems/explorer.html](https://jkylearmstrong.github.io/mixed.sign.coxeter.systems/explorer.html) (no installation required), or run the full local Shiny for Python app backed by `mixed_sign_coxeter` and `data/theorems.yml`:

```bash
pip install -r explorer/requirements.txt
shiny run explorer/app.py
```

## Slides & Website

```bash
# Manim slides (requires LaTeX for MathTex)
pip install -e ".[manim]"
manim -pql slides/dissertation_deck.py TitleOverviewScene

# Render the full Quarto portal or README.md
quarto render
quarto render README.qmd
```
